overview.text: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) is procuring subscription services for Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (JBOSS EAP) and Extended Life Support (ELS) for a one-year term. The tender involves supply, implementation, and enabling support services to upgrade from the unsupported JBoss 5 version.

issuing_organization: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)

scope.text: Supply of Red Hat JBoss EAP support subscription and Red Hat JBoss EAP Extended Life Support (ELS) support subscription.
Services include supply, implementation, commissioning, maintenance, upgrades, updates, patches, and technical assistance within 48 hours of purchase order issuance.
Deliverables include valid support subscriptions, access credentials, documentation, and compliance/audit records for OEM Licensed products only.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit EMD of ₹2,76,000 (exempt for MSEs with Udyam Certificate) and a Pre-Contract Integrity Pact on ₹500 stamp paper.
Successful bidders must submit KYC forms, sign Service Level Agreement (SLA), Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), and provide audited financial statements for the last three FYs.
Bidders must declare no debarment since 01.04.2021 and provide proof of three purchase orders from the last three years.

eligibility.text: Bidders must be duly organized entities capable of independent support and not bankrupt or insolvent.
Violations of the Integrity Pact or incorrect declarations regarding transgressions lead to disqualification and exclusion from future business.

important_dates.text: Last date for bid submission: 1st October 2025, 3:00 PM; Technical Bid opening: 03rd October 2025.
Bids remain valid for 180 days from the last date of opening; SLA reviewed at least once per fiscal year.

commercial_requirements.text: Prices quoted must remain firm for one year with no escalation; EMD is refundable unless bid is rejected.
Payments are released upon supply and acceptance of subscriptions; Service Provider liability for SLA breaches is limited to 10% of the agreement cost.

project_duration.text: Subscription services are valid for one year from activation unless otherwise specified in the purchase order.
Integrity Pact expires 12 months after last payment for contractors and 6 months after award for other bidders.

important_conditions.text: Confidential Information must be returned or destroyed upon termination; no side agreements allowed without written changes.
Contract may be terminated for unjustifiable delays, failure to upgrade software, or non-attendance of after-sales calls (3+ occasions).
Disputes resolved amicably within 30 days, then via sole arbitration in Mumbai under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
